$comment: Machine-readable fork layer for this marketplace. The prose version, with the
licence snapshots and the reasoning, stays in THIRD_PARTY_INSPIRATIONS.md - this
file is the part scripts/upstream-delta.py can measure, and the two are meant to
relation uses the SAME vocabulary as attribution.relationship in SKILL.md (WM canon
2026-08-05): vendored | adaptation | pattern-only | clean-room | dependency | original.
Deliberately not a second private vocabulary - the gate cross-checks the two, and a
skill claiming LESS provenance than the manifest records is a blocking finding.
map entries override the upstream-level relation, and are set to what the skill
itself declares; mapping an 'original' skill is legitimate and strict - it polices a
no-source claim against the nearest upstream somebody might think it came from.
pin is written only by `python scripts/upstream-delta.py sync`, and only after the
checkout is verified complete - never by hand.

upstreams.note: Polish adaptation, so line-level text similarity is near zero by construction. Read struct, and read it as a question for a human, not as proof of anything. MIT notice travels in jakosc-tresci/skills/humanizer-pl/NOTICE.txt.

upstreams.license: CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0 on the curation; per-skill licence declared in each upstream SKILL.md frontmatter
upstreams.note: The two forks are Apache-2.0 per the author's own frontmatter; everything else here is a PATTERN ONLY claim that CC-BY-NC-ND makes load-bearing. The EU AI Act claim covers an eleven-skill suite and is policed against the closest single upstream (quick-assessment); the other ten are unpoliced - a known gap, not a clean result.

Six verification skills take architecture patterns from lavern (debate roles, mechanical grounding, post-assembly verifier, router classification, audit bundle). Upstream is TypeScript, ours is markdown: there is no comparable text surface, so this claim cannot be machine-checked here. Left visible on purpose rather than dropped.

Nasz kalkulatory-procesowe-pl SCALA cztery osobne skille upstreamu (oplata-sadowa, odsetki, WPS, alimenty) w jeden plik. Para 1:1 NIE istnieje, a wymuszenie jej dalo by wysoka pozorna oryginalnosc z samej konstrukcji (merge zawsze slabo przypomina kazda czesc z osobna). Zostaje UNMEASURED swiadomie - lepiej brak liczby niz liczba, ktora klamie w nasza strone.
Pola memo negocjacyjnego i skan placeholderow przed wysylka; skrypty napisane od zera w Pythonie stdlib. Para 1:1 istnieje, wiec deklaracja jest mierzalna.
redline-docx-pl calls `uvx adeu`. No adeu code carried.
markitdown skill is a usage wrapper over the installed CLI.
opendataloader-pdf skill is a usage wrapper over the installed converter.
legal-data-hunter-pl runs the collectors as separate processes. AGPL makes the process boundary the point: carrying any of this code would change the licence of the hub.
